description.en: Swings in on a vine to lane midway onto your lawn.
description.zh: 抓着藤蔓进入草坪的中央。

chat.en: Relic Hunter has hunted some pretty impressive relic in his days. Idols, antiques, curios... he's hunted 'em all.
chat.zh: 遗迹猎宝僵尸曾猎取过一些令人印象深刻的文物。偶像、古董、古玩……他都猎过。

text.en: lands four to six tiles into your lawn
text.zh: 直接越过四到六格进入你的草坪
